body.statement: Determine whether deciding \(r(G,s)\leq3\) for finite simple bow-free ADMGs with singleton target \(s\) has a polynomial-time algorithm, or whether it is \(\mathsf{coNP}\)-complete, using the fixed-point hedge oracle to certify \(r(G,s)>3\).
body.justification: Promise recognition is the genuine unresolved algorithmic boundary left visible by the certifying interface.
body.gap: Neither bounded-size enumeration in Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash nor the solver encodings of Elahi and coauthors classify the complexity of recognizing that no larger minimal hedge exists.
body.consumer: A resolution determines whether low-rank preprocessing can be invoked automatically or must remain a promise-or-counterexample workflow.
